task.title: Save your recovery words
task.shortdesc: Your 12 recovery words are the only way to bring your profile back on a new phone. Save them somewhere safe.

taskbody.context: The words are created when you finish setup. After your first match, a Keep your profile safe card on the Me tab reminds you to save them; its See my words button opens the same screen as these steps.

step.cmd: Tap Recovery words, then Show my words.
Write the words down in order, or tap Copy.

postreq.note: Anyone with these words can be you on . Never share them, not even with us.
